description.fallback: Caesar stumbles upon Joseph in front of Lisa Lisa's room and jumps to conclusions about why he is there. However, Joseph calms him down and tells him that Esidisi's brain has stolen Suzi Q's body. Esidisi tries to turn Caesar against Joseph and Lisa Lisa by crying and pretending that he is actually just Suzi Q.
